integrity.reproducibility: Self-contained verify.py uses two independent state generators, two Kempe-component algorithms, and all-source BFS.
integrity.scope: Exact ten-vertex Petersen graph; 20 palette-orbits and 120 labelled states.

scientific_limitations: Applies to proper vertex three-colourings of the Petersen graph, with one connected-component Kempe interchange per step.
The exact metric of the 120-state labelled graph is proved by exhaustive finite computation, not by a general cubic-graph theorem.
A relevant 2018 paper on perfect three-colourings was accessible only as abstract; prior unindexed work remains possible.
Independent audit and validation were not performed.
title: Petersen three-colouring Kempe graph: an oriented-edge quotient and sharp diameter
